user.title: Heating Intelligence
user.description: Set up read-only heating analysis. Configure rooms and global sensors after setup.

global_settings.title: Global settings
global_settings.description: Select the heating-only cumulative gas meter (not combined hot water), environmental sensors, boiler efficiency assumption and total external envelope area.

data.gas_consumption_entity: Heating-only cumulative gas consumption (m³ or kWh)

add_room.title: Add a room
add_room.description: Select the room's floor, thermostat demand relay and temperature sensor. Floor area is optional. The window contact is optional.

data.enable_co2: Add a CO2 sensor for this room

add_room_co2.title: Add room CO2 sensor
add_room_co2.description: Select the CO2 sensor for {room_name}. CO2 is optional and only requested when enabled for this room.

room_area.title: Select room
room_area.description: Choose the room whose floor area you want to configure.

set_room_area.title: Room floor area
set_room_area.description: Set the floor area for {room_name}. Leave empty if unknown.

pump_settings.title: Pump settings
pump_settings.description: Select instantaneous power (W) and cumulative energy (kWh) sensors for each manifold pump. Leave both fields empty to omit a pump.

edit_room.title: Select room
edit_room.description: Choose the room whose floor assignment you want to change.

edit_room_floor.title: Change room floor
edit_room_floor.description: Set the floor for {room_name}. The currently saved floor is selected by default.

abort.no_rooms: There are no rooms to remove.
